loading.title: Getting Kvale ready …
loading.body: The first time can take a moment. After that it is quicker.
loading.restore: The pattern you were working on will open in a moment.
autosave.hint: Your work is saved automatically here in the browser. Press “Save” to get a file you can keep.
file.label: File
file.save.hint: Download the pattern as a file so you can open it again – Ctrl+S
file.export.hint: Download the whole band as a picture (PNG), with backstitch and ends
lang.label: Language
theme.label: Appearance
mode.label: View
tool.label: Stitch
tool.cross.hint: Stitch crosses in the chosen colour. Drag to stitch several.
tool.back.hint: Stitch backstitch along the grid lines. The line carries on from the last point until you stop.
tool.unpick.hint: Remove cross stitches or backstitch (with a mouse: right-click)
zoom.fit.hint: Show the whole pattern on screen
target.label: Drawing in
target.unit.hint: The pattern that repeats along the band
target.corner.hint: give the corner its own finish
target.edge.hint: Give the band its own finish here
end.where.left: The first repeat on the left.
end.where.right: The last repeat on the right.
end.explain: What you stitch or unpick here only changes this end. The rest of the band follows the repeat.
end.extra.hint: Makes room for a border outside the repeat
end.summary.none: No changes yet – this end matches the repeat.
end.reset.hint: Remove every change here, including extra rows and columns. You will be asked first.
end.confirm.title: Reset this end?
end.confirm.body: {name} will match the repeat again. This will be lost:
end.confirm.corners: Stitches in the corners that lie in these rows or columns: {n}
end.confirm.undo: If you change your mind, you can undo it afterwards.
corner.where.tl: Where the top edge meets the left end.
corner.where.tr: Where the top edge meets the right end.
corner.where.bl: Where the bottom edge meets the left end.
corner.where.br: Where the bottom edge meets the right end.
corner.explain: The corner starts out as the two ends make it. What you stitch or unpick here only changes this corner – also in the square where the extra rows and columns cross.
corner.size: Its size follows the extra rows and columns of the two ends beside it.
corner.summary.none: No changes yet – the corner matches the ends beside it.
corner.confirm.title: Reset this corner?
corner.confirm.body: {name} will match the ends beside it again. This will be lost:
legend.neighbourEnds: The ends beside it – for reference only
canvas.hint.cross: Tap or drag across the squares to stitch. Right-click unpicks.
canvas.hint.back: Tap a corner to start, then the next corner to stitch a line. The line carries on from the last point, so you can stitch several lines in a row. To stop: press Esc, tap the last point again, or choose another stitch.
canvas.hint.unpick: Tap a stitch or a backstitch line to unpick it.
canvas.hint.edges: Tap a number along the edge to add or remove a row or column.
canvas.hint.end: The faded part is the next repeat, so you can see how the end meets the rest of the band.
canvas.hint.corner: The faded parts are the ends beside it, so you can see how the corner meets them.
band.mini.title: How the band will look
band.mini.hint: Tap an end or a corner of the band to give it its own finish.
preview.caption: {rx} × {ry} repeats · {w} × {h} stitches
preview.hint: This is the whole band. Go to “Draw” to change it.
threads.title: Threads in this pattern
edge.col.title: Column {n}
edge.row.title: Row {n}
colours.useSeq: Change colour from repeat to repeat
colours.useSeq.hint: For colours with several threads. Off: only the first is used.
colours.background.hint: The background colour of the pattern
symmetry.intro: Choose how your stitches are mirrored in the repeat.
symmetry.squareNotice: These only work when the repeat is as wide as it is tall. It is now {w} × {h} stitches.
symmetry.switchedOff: The repeat is no longer square, so turning and diagonal mirroring are switched off.
grid.unit.hint: The area you draw in. It repeats across and down the band.
grid.repeats.hint: How many times the repeat is used (1–100).
edges.title: Where repeats meet
edges.explain: If a mirror line runs along the very edge of the repeat, that row or column is doubled where two repeats meet. Switch it off to let neighbouring repeats share it.
edges.off.left: Shared – only stitched at the far left
edges.off.right: Shared – only stitched at the far right
edges.off.top: Shared – only stitched at the very top
edges.off.bottom: Shared – only stitched at the very bottom
dialog.title: Colour {n}
dialog.intro: One thread colour, or several that change from repeat to repeat.
dialog.parts: Tap a part to choose its colour
dialog.howItRepeats: How the colour changes along the band:
dialog.offNote: Colour change is switched off – only part 1 is used now.
thread.title: Choose a thread
thread.system.hint: The numbers in the list are {system} numbers. More thread brands may come later.
thread.namesNote: Colour names are in English, as {system} writes them.
thread.none: Nothing found. Try a {system} number, e.g. 321.
thread.approx: Screen colours are approximate. Check against a shade card when the colour must match.
thread.pickPrompt: Choose a colour from the list.
lines.title: Rows and columns
lines.action: What do you want to do?
lines.symNote: The symmetry takes more than the one you chose, so the pattern stays the same.
lines.cantRemove: Not possible – the repeat needs at least one row and one column.
canvas.hint.minimal: You only stitch in the outlined part – the rest is mirrored automatically.
file.unsaved: Changes not saved to a file
file.saveAs.hint: Ctrl+Shift+S: save a copy under a new name
file.confirmDiscard: Changes that are not saved to a file will be lost. Continue?
file.error.notPattern: This file is not a Kvale pattern.
file.error.tooNew: This pattern was made with a newer version of Kvale. Reload the page and try again.
file.error.fetch: Could not find the pattern in the link.
file.error.export: Could not make the image. Please try again.
